_comment: Paste into ~/.codex/hooks.json on the operator's machine, and set
This points Codex at the same gate Claude Code runs, so the two agents are
given one decision procedure rather than two that can drift. The gate is
.claude/hooks/production-gate.mjs in this repository; it reads the production
and staging refs from scripts/deployment-boundary-lib.mjs, which is the single
source of truth for which project is which.
Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO with the checkout path. It is absolute because
Codex's working directory is not guaranteed to be the repository root.
WHAT THIS IS WORTH. Enforced against the model: hooks run out-of-process, the
model never executes them and cannot skip them. Advisory against a determined
process on the same machine, because this file and the gate are writable by the
agent running under them. Root-owned managed configuration is the fix and is
not in place -- see RECONCILIATION-2026-10-03.md section 6, item 10.
AND IT DOES NOT REACH THE BROWSER. Codex's hooks fire for CLI tool use, which
Codex itself confirmed in the 3 October review. A click in a logged-in
dashboard is not a tool call and nothing here sees it. That path is addressed
